news.title: Microsoft is reportedly training salespeople to talk down OpenAI and Anthropic
news.description: Microsoft is looking to sell its in-house AI models as more efficient and cost-effective than its competitors' models.

news.title: Amid hardware legal battle, OpenAI releases a $230 keyboard for Codex
news.description: OpenAI, which is in the middle of a legal battle with Apple over hardware trade theft allegations, just released a light-up keyboard designed to be paired with its agentic coding app.

news.title: Thinking Machines amps up its bet against one-size-fits-all AI with its first open model, Inkling
news.description: It's the company's first public proof point after a year and a half spent building AI infrastructure largely out of public view.

news.title: Hack suggests AI music generator Suno scraped YouTube for training data
news.description: The hacker used an employee's credentials to access source code, which revealed how Suno scraped decades of audio.

news.title: Meta pulls new AI image feature after days of backlash
news.description: Meta's release this week of an AI feature that let people alter Instagram content drew swift blowback.

news.title: Is the Assassin's Creed Black Flag remake worth the 13 year wait?
news.description: The BBC's Tom Gerken plays the much-anticipated pirate game which has been remade from the ground up.

news.title: AI Isn’t Smarter Than a Baby—Yet
news.description: Babies are tremendous learning machines, and key advances for AI may soon be found in the architecture of their little brains.

news.title: An Inventor of Apple’s FaceID Wants to Analyze Your Brain’s Health With AI
news.description: Gidi Littwin’s new AI startup, Hemispheric, makes diagnostic brain scans for conditions like depression, PTSD, and Parkinson’s. He wants the technology to be as cheap and easy as for a blood test.
